title: How 3,800 DNA Sites Proved Us Wrong – David Reich

that had been found before seemed to

was very promising in theory, might

was the situation we found ourselves in

18,000 years is about 16,000 people. So,

when you have more data, you can

more subtlety. And the data comes from

due to historical reasons. And it
provides us with a natural laboratory
where we can see what happens over one
place over time as environments change
to the genome. It's really interesting
to imagine doing this type of analysis
in other parts of the world. And the
comparative analyses are super important
and interesting, but this study right
now is about this one place in the world
where we have particularly fantastic
data. The other thing we did is we
developed an entirely new methodology

a technique that had been developed for

explain it is we ask how to predict the

if we include the ancient and modern
people.

other.

people.

blowing the frequency of the mutation in
the same direction in all geographic

samples in the database. So, we're

the alternative hypothesis is that
selection has been blowing in the same

if that explains the data better. And
that's a a dumb assumption uh because of

um the impact of different bottlenecks

change in this consistent direction over

50% confident that they're real, we

is like a crazy number of results given

thought it must be wrong, and we spent

independent type of evidence to tell us

blood pressure or something like this.

70 that are
are affecting the trade when we slide
